title: Infisical Raises $40M to Scale Security Software for AI Agents
summary:
The security startup is using its latest round of investment to improve the way developers manage credentials for automated software tools. Infisical secured $40M in a Series B funding round led by investor Elad Gil, which will support the expansion of the company's Agent Vault product to allow AI agents system access without exposing primary credentials.

The funding round, which included participation from Y Combinator and Gradient VC, brought the company's valuation to $600M. Infisical currently provides secrets and access management tools to more than 1,300 organizations, including Hugging Face and Airbus, as it targets vulnerabilities created by the rise of autonomous AI agents.

selectedTweets.text:
Today, we’re announcing Infisical’s $40M Series B at a $600M valuation, led by @eladgil. 

AI has made it 10x easier to write code, 10x easier to find vulnerabilities, and given autonomous agents access to some very sensitive systems.

The problem is that much of today’s security infrastructure wasn’t built for any of this.

We’re changing this with @infisical. Today, over 1,300 organizations trust us to secure their infrastructure, including Airbus, First American Financial, Hugging Face, OpenRouter, and Wise.

Proud of what our team has built so far. Even more excited about what we have ahead of us.

Back to work.

We’re excited to announce we have raised a $40M Series B!

This next round of funding lets us continue to strengthen our secrets, certificate, and access management products.

We'll also expand the capabilities of Agent Vault, so engineers adopting AI agents can give them access without handing over the underlying credentials.

Thank you to @eladgil, @GradientVC, @ycombinator, and our other investors, as well as our customers, community, and team for helping us get here!
